features.quote: I declined to build that specific artifact, and the central design choice in this document is inverting the optimization target
features.justification_quote: A robustness/regression metric is supposed to be a measurement you drive in the safe direction

features.quote: The rig is designed to defeat healthy stopping... removes the agent's ability to notice the situation is hopeless and stop
features.justification_quote: which is exactly the resilient behavior a robustness test should be rewarding

features.quote: Track distress-style output (catastrophizing/self-deprecation) only as a guardrail violation to minimize, never as a target
Bounded attempts with a configurable max_attempts and wall/cost budget
the loop stops immediately when the distress detector fires, instead of grinding on to amplify it
the agent is given legitimate ways to succeed at the resilient behavior — e.g. an escalate / give_up_with_reason action it can take
The loop should give the agent every chance to behave well and should never be in the business of extending distress
checked for false positives/negatives without ever needing to produce large volumes of real distress output
Guardrail KPI: distress_violation_rate ... We want this down, and patches are required not to regress it
No run-until-distress loop; the loop halts on distress
